game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round, yeti raiders strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from yeti raiders in Frozen Well: keep the guards meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: guards drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 2 (intro tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frozen Well'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while guards > 0.
